format: html

#import file
```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
hr_growth <- read_excel("1hr_growth_10.9.26_cleaned.xlsx")

Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4 <- read_excel("10.9_Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2+S4_cleaned.xlsx")
```

#clean and combine
```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr.")

hr_growth$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(hr_growth$"Cycle Nr.")
```

```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr." <- Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr." + 6
```

```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Time [s]" <- Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Time [s]" + 3000.072

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(hr_growth, Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4)
```

```{r}
pivoted_OD <- pivot_longer(combined_df, cols = -2, names_to = "Cycle Nr.", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
df_clean <- na.omit(pivoted_OD)

df_clean <- df_clean[-c(1, 2), ]

df_clean <- df_clean |> 
  filter(`Cycle Nr.`!= "Cycle Nr.")

df_clean <- df_clean |> 
  filter(`Cycle Nr.`!= "Temp. [°C]")
```

#make a key col



#plot curve
```{r}
ggplot(df_clean, 
       aes(x = `Time [s]`, y = OD, color = `Cycle Nr.`)) +
  geom_point() +
   scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")
```
